provider: CUHK Faculty of Science Natural Sciences curriculum
academicYear: Concentration Requirements for 2026-27 and thereafter; reviewed on 2026-07-29
note: The current official Faculty of Science curriculum page defines Natural Sciences as a two-year senior-entry Programme requiring at least 69 units for graduation. Its 51-unit Major requirement includes at least 32 science units from one of seven Concentrations: Biological Sciences, Biotechnology, Environmental Studies, Food and Nutrition, Data Science, Chemical and Testing Sciences, or Physical Sciences. This supplement exposes the union of all 40 uniquely coded courses explicitly named in the 2026-27-and-thereafter Required Courses tables. Shared and alternative-course membership is preserved in each course group. The page defines the remaining Concentration and outside-Concentration electives only through open BCHE, BIOL, CHEM, CMBI, EESC, FNSC, LSCI, MATH, MBTE, PHYS, RMSC and STAT course pools, with level, laboratory and research-unit constraints; it does not publish closed code lists for those pools. CHEM2110, CHEM2120, CHEM2200 and CHEM2300 are an any-three group worth 7-8 units, while the six Physical Sciences foundation choices form an any-two 6-unit group, so their individual credits remain 0 rather than being inferred from group totals. The official brochure visually confirms the seven-Concentration and 51-unit structure but does not add current course codes. Because the open elective universes and complete 51-unit paths are not closed by the public page, this 40-course required-code list is intentionally browse-only and must not produce a graduation completion percentage.
